name: Indiana University Southeast
oos_note: Public university (southeast.iu.edu). Non-resident undergraduate tuition & fees = $22,811 for 2024-25 (in-state $8,424), per CollegeTuitionCompare and Univstats (both citing IPEDS/IU data). Official IU Student Central 2025-26 rate pages were unreachable during research; the known in-state $8,616 appears to be 2025-26, so the confirmed 2025-26 non-resident figure may be slightly higher than the reported 2024-25 $22,811. Reported the most recent verifiable non-resident tuition & fees figure; not inflated/estimated.
